text: At last they reached Naniwa Bay, where Osaka stands today, and marched across the mountains toward Yamato.
spoken: At last they reached Nah-nee-wah Bay, where Osaka stands today, and marched across the mountains toward Yah-mah-toh.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, po nazwie, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
